mapper.update: CREATE DATABASE `${database.value}` CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = #{table}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = #{table} AND column_name = #{column}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_schema = DATABASE() AND constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'
mapper.update: ALTER TABLE user_preference ADD CONSTRAINT reject_test_user CHECK (user_id <> 'rejected-user')
CREATE TRIGGER p03_fail_run_job BEFORE INSERT ON background_job FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF NEW.kind = 'run' THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = '执行测试主动拒绝任务保存'; END IF; END
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits w JOIN performance_schema.data_locks l ON l.ENGINE_LOCK_ID = w.REQUESTING_ENGINE_LOCK_ID WHERE l.OBJECT_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND l.OBJECT_NAME = 'enterprise'
SELECT @@version AS version, @@innodb_buffer_pool_size AS bufferPoolBytes, @@max_connections AS maximumConnections
SELECT id FROM enterprise WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM api_request WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
